correctness.rationale: The neighborhood equations are exact for both seam conventions. Adding gives s_{i+3}=s_i and subtracting gives d_{i+3}=-d_i; the occupancy multiset restriction (2,0,0) or (1,1,0) yields exactly three V and six H periodic words. Their shift and row-swap symmetries prove all four code count regimes. Each code has size 2n/3 by cubic double counting. Exhaustive bitwise testing of the displayed nine words gives exactly six disjoint covering triples, while the three V patterns give one triple; seam periodicity justifies lifting these triples to all permitted widths. Definition-level independent graph construction checks 699008 masks across 14 graph profiles and the claimed formulas at 296 periodic profiles; finite checks corroborate rather than replace proof.

originality.rationale: Reviewed closely relevant existence and construction results in Cartesian prisms, Cayley regular sets, and Möbius ladder colorings. They establish existence or exhibit codes, but not the all-code multiplicities or all-partition incidence. A known perfect matching census on these families does not imply this different code property. Searches under the three primary aliases and graph synonyms yielded no covering statement, though bibliographic priority risk persists.
residual_risks: Unindexed EOD or total-perfect-code enumerations of these families may precede this classification under a different name.

value.rationale: The exact full classification refines a known existence question on two natural connected cubic families and quantifies all efficient open-neighborhood tilings. Changing only the closing orientation exchanges 3 versus 9 solutions, and also 1 versus 6 decompositions into three codes, in opposite residues mod 6. This structural holonomy/parity effect and complete solution incidence are not captured by the pre-existing existence and construction results.
